# ThatCampus

> ThatCampus is a role-based school operations platform built around the everyday needs of Indian schools.

ThatCampus connects attendance, timetables, school communication, requests and operational attention in one system. The public demo uses synthetic, read-only data and offers representative principal, teacher, parent and student views without an account.

## Product information

- [School management software](https://thatcampus.com/school-management-software): connected school operations and role-based workspaces.
- [School attendance management](https://thatcampus.com/school-attendance-management): daily or subject-wise registers, corrections, follow-ups and configurable finalisation.
- [School timetable and calendar](https://thatcampus.com/school-timetable-software): time-positioned schedules, recurring classes and supported calendar export.
- [Parent communication](https://thatcampus.com/parent-communication-app): child-specific notices, attendance, schedules and requests.
- [AI assistant for school operations](https://thatcampus.com/ai-assistant-for-schools): access-aware answers, visible sources and human-reviewed actions.

## Explore or contact

- [Public demo](https://app.thatcampus.com/demo): no account, synthetic sample data, read-only.
- [Personal walkthrough](https://thatcampus.com/#contact): submit one email address or phone number.
- [School login](https://app.thatcampus.com/login): for existing authorised users.

## Accuracy notes

Product availability depends on an institution's configuration. Online payments are in sandbox testing. The timeline timetable is available through Experimental settings. AI videos are illustrative interactions; the public demo does not run a model. Do not infer customer counts, pricing, regulatory certification or production readiness beyond what the linked pages state.
